'''Basharande''' was a kingdom of the [[Third Age#Free Years|Free Years]]. It was founded after the end of the [[Trolloc Wars]], and was established on the former territory of [[Jaramide]]. It was later absorbed by the growing might of [[Artur Hawkwing's Empire]]. Basharande was one of the [[Borderlands]] in its day and also a militarily strong nation. The lands it once held are now controlled by [[Saldaea]].

==Geography==
[[Image:Basharande.png|thumb|right|200px|In red location within the Westlands]]

Basharande was the northwesternmost nation in the [[Westlands]], stretching from [[World's End]] to the [[Plain of Lances]] and from the [[Great Blight|Blight]] almost to the [[Mountains of Mist]]. Its neighbors were [[Abayan]], [[Indrahar]], and [[Oburun]] to the south and [[Elsalam]] to the east. The [[Arinelle|River Arinelle]] was a major trade artery of the kingdom.

==History==
Relatively little is known of Basharande, save that it had a strong martial tradition and sent troops to fight the [[false Dragon]] [[Guaire Amalasan]] in the [[War of the Second Dragon]]. It was later conquered by [[Artur Paendrag Tanreall|Artur Hawkwing]] and made part of his empire as the Province of Saldaea. Lord Rylen t'Boriden Rashad, the governor of the province at the time of Hawkwing's death, declared Saldaea to be a sovereign nation shortly after Hawkwing's death and made alliance with the other Borderland kingdoms to stand against any threat from the south as well as from the Blight during the subsequent [[War of the Hundred Years]].

The name bears a striking resemblance to [[Bashere (location)|Bashere]], a region of modern day [[Saldaea]].
